proposed_sites.snippet: mcp = FastMCP("MCP Gateway to AWS Lambda")

tool is an MCP SDK tool object returned from mcp_client.get_available_tools() (via session.list_tools()); in v2 the field is renamed from camelCase inputSchema to snake_case input_schema, so tool.inputSchema must become tool.input_schema.
